tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Eataly is a world-renowned concept that celebrates the finest Italian foods. It always includes a large speciality market alongside superb dining options, such as this chic restaurant with its expansive terrace overlooking the cityscape. It should come as no surprise that authentic Italian cuisine takes centre stage. Think vitello tonnato with its delicate harmony of veal and tuna, al dente tagliatelle with pistachio pesto and red prawn tartare, or a creative take on tiramisu – the chefs pay tribute to traditional flavours while introducing a touch of flair. The extensive menu will definitely leave you spoilt for choice!
